# ractermx_security_score (Data Source)

Reads the security posture score for a RacterMX domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the security posture score for a domain.
data "ractermx_security_score" "example" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
}

output "security_grade" {
  value = data.ractermx_security_score.example.grade
}

output "overall_score" {
  value = data.ractermx_security_score.example.overall_score
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain.

### Read-Only

- `grade` (String) The overall security grade.
- `overall_score` (Number) The overall security posture score.
- `pillars` (Attributes List) Breakdown of scores by security pillar. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pillars))

<a id="nestedatt--pillars"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pillars`

Read-Only:

- `grade` (String) The grade for this pillar.
- `name` (String) The name of the security pillar.
- `score` (Number) The score for this pillar.
